name: Piedmont
about: Foggy autumns, cold winters, warm summers. Alba's white truffle season (Oct–Nov) is a real, dated culinary event, not year-round like the wine.
overview: Barolo and Barbaresco country in Italy's northwest — rolling vineyard hills, white truffles, and a genuinely continental climate unlike coastal Tuscany.
costOverview: Piedmont is affordable day to day — coffee and the Alba Truffle Fair entry are both cheap — but a white truffle tasting menu is one of the most expensive meals you can order anywhere, and it's the whole reason many visitors come in the fall.

specialSeasons.text: The Alba International White Truffle Fair runs through this window — the region's genuine culinary peak, distinct from the wine harvest a month earlier.
